additional_info.subject: ID0460412-DC/Si-D/NL-[Multi] Firmware update CRM:02873000017
additional_info.body:
Hello Erik, good morning. I hope you are doing well.
We cannot do this at 3am night time. Our working schedule is from 8am CET to 6pm CET. Please convey this information to the customer and find a timestamp that suits them.
Otherwise, someone from the region with access to SCB can do the updates.
I will wait for your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0460412-DC/Si-D/NL-[Multi] Firmware update CRM:02873000017
additional_info.body:
Hi Francisco,
Thanks for your reply.
Please update the chargers from 8:30 till 9:30h in the morning. Both Thursday and Friday are okay.
The customer asks to update chargers on the same location after oneanother. It’s probably routine to do so. But it seems wise to share his concerns.
Kind regards, Vriendelijke groet,

additional_info.subject: ID0460412-DC/Si-D/NL-[Multi] Firmware update CRM:02873000017
additional_info.body:
Hi Erik,
Thanks for the feedback.
I just want to confirm if I'm not mistaken. What he means one after the other is, I update one and only after it's finished, I start the next one, yes?
If yes, then it will take more time than just 1h, each update can take up to 30mins, so in the case, I could only update 2 per day per location.
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0460412-DC/Si-D/NL-[Multi] Firmware update CRM:02873000017
additional_info.body:
That’s right. Start the next after the previous one is finished.
A fifteen-minute delay after 9:30 shouldn't be a problem. If there's a location with three chargers, you can also do two charges first and then the third. The point is that there should always be charging capacity available.
Kind regards, Vriendelijke groet,
Erik-Jan Voogt
Account Manager eTruck
Heliox
